objective: Monsoon floor: hold renewals with a race-entry story, protect August's race with a paid month, and refill the front with a 21-day challenge.
strategy:
Rain Check.

Commercial job: Monsoon floor: hold renewals with a race-entry story, protect August's race with a paid month, and refill the front with a 21-day challenge.

Newcomer: Kickstart 21: Race Ready (“21 days. A race entry. 20% off when you finish.”). A time-boxed challenge with a finish line the client can see beats a discount; the race gives 21 July starts a reason to keep paying into August.

Newcomer: Warm-Up Lap (“Two weeks in, then 20% off if you stay.”). For people who won't commit before trying — the intro pays for itself and the 72-hour window closes it.

Winback: Midyear Report Card (“See your 2026 in classes. Then get back to your best.”). Personal data is the most persuasive message a lapsed client can get, and it retargets the black hole.

Renewal: Rain Check Renewal (“Rainy day? Freeze it. 20% off your next 3 months.”). Monsoon is the softest month for attendance; the freeze option removes the excuse to lapse and 20% moves 1M onto 3M before August.
notes:
Moment: P57 Amazing Race 2.0 sign-ups open (race final 8–9 Aug at Kwality); Rain Check cards handed to every lapsed client who restarts.
Build: new clients 40 buyers × ₹13,000 = ₹5.2L; reactivation 30 × ₹11,468 = ₹3.4L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹2.0L; renewals ₹20.9L. First visits needed 160; CRM leads needed 199.

keyDates.name: Kickstart 21 begins
keyDates.note: 21 July starts run to mid-August, into the race.

items.detail: Set up Kickstart 21: Race Ready in Momence (1–21 Jul.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) — 21 classes in 21 days unlocks the race entry (₹1,000 per pair) and a 20% credit toward your next month.
Set up Warm-Up Lap in Momence (All July.): A 7-Day Unlimited Intro at ₹1,999 — ₹1,999 credited and 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) if you buy within 72 hours.
Set up Midyear Report Card in Momence (1–20 Jul.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) — a printed 12-month report card and one 30-min private.
Set up Rain Check Renewal in Momence (All July.): 3 Months Unlimited at 20% off (₹46,284) — 2 freezes and a priority place in the Amazing Race 2.0 team draw.
Brief the team on the 4 July offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Kickstart 21: Race Ready to First-time clients.
Launch Warm-Up Lap to First-time clients.
Launch Midyear Report Card to Lapsed clients.
Launch Rain Check Renewal to Members renewing in July.
Run the month's moment: P57 Amazing Race 2.0 sign-ups open (race final 8–9 Aug at Kwality); Rain Check cards handed to every lapsed client who restarts.

Weekly check: Kickstart 21: Race Ready: Day-21 finish rate (target 50%); race sign-ups. | Warm-Up Lap: Intro conversion. | Midyear Report Card: Report cards sent; conversations held; purchases. | Rain Check Renewal: 3M renewals; freezes used.
Mid-month review against ₹31.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 185 renewals, 30 reactivations and 40 new buyers (140 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close July: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief August's offers.
